_description: Built-in corpora of the layout analysis: each names a text of static/corpus whose entry in static/corpus/register.json has status « ship »; its licence, attribution and source are read from that register (one source). The codegen (tools/codegen/codegen-layout-analysis-data-js.cjs) ships their n-gram tables, never the text, in _shared/ui/layout_analysis/_generated/corpus_<id>.js, with the licence in each file's header. « restore_dead_key_pairs » turns the two-character spellings the old KLA conversion wrote (^e, ¨i) back into the accented letter; it stays off for code, where ^ is an operator. « strip_sentence_numbers » removes the « number<TAB> » prefix of each line of a Leipzig sentence file.
